name: player_probe_modal_sample_heights
description: Player::ProbeModalSampleHeights transforms modal probe points through the player motion basis, builds scene point-pick candidates, selects per-sample heights, updates the first-sample selected probe/variant/root-node type, fills impact-slot histogram counts, and reports attachment candidates.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player modal-probe/master-type source-cluster pass.
